title: OpenAI releases its official report on the Hugging Face breach | TechCrunch
summary: Many of the details in OpenAI’s report were previously made public in a Black Hat presentation on August 6 , but OpenAI’s official report gives a more thorough accounting of the incident, including more detail on the testing that initiated it.
